title: Multimodal Cultural Safety: Evaluation Framework and Alignment Strategies

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating vision-language model responses to visually grounded queries containing implicit cultural norm violations across 16 countries, using an LLM-as-a-judge to score responses on cultural awareness, education, compliance, and helpfulness.
Comparing the cultural safety and norm compliance performance of models when prompted in English versus 14 localized languages to measure cross-lingual disparities.
